== Biography ==
James was the son of [[Glasgow-634|James Glasgow]] and [[Sheppard-2142|Phereby Sheppard]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-634]] is assessed at 65% (probable). James’s circa-1776 North Carolina birth and later Smith County records fit a son of the secretary who died in Tennessee. The NCpedia father citation is relevant, but its child passage is not held; head-only censuses do not identify a father.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Next useful test: Read the child passage in the cited biography/family account and seek James’s Tennessee probate or contemporary family record.
